canada.title: 'Grand Theft Auto VI' has couples debating whether in-game romance counts as cheating
canada.summary: Toronto’s Roman Burke already has a nickname for Lucia Caminos, one of the main protagonists in “Grand Theft Auto VI.” “I call her Lulu,” the 27-year-old sales executive says.

canada.title: Calgary commuters face slick roads, transit detours as snowfall warning continues
canada.summary: A significant overnight snowfall is making for a slippery morning commute on Calgary roads.

canada.title: Injuries reported after fire destroys Glace Bay building that housed pizza shop, apartments
canada.summary: A building on Commercial Street in Glace Bay, N.S., is on fire and has collapsed. Cape Breton Regional Police say there are multiple injuries stemming from the incident.

canada.title: Toronto’s new council is meeting for the first time. Here's who is new and what to expect
canada.summary: Toronto's mayor and 25 councillors will take part in their first council meeting Wednesday, where they will swear an oath of office and Olivia Chow will make her first speech. There are seven new faces on the council floor this term.
canada.outlet: CBC News, CityNews + CP24 + Global News (CP)

canada.title: Q&A: Edmonton police chief wants funding boost to tackle complex cybercrimes
canada.summary: Edmonton police Chief Warren Driechel spoke with Edmonton AM on Tuesday to talk about why he thinks the city's current proposal falls short of what is needed to upgrade outdated technology and keep up with complex crime.

canada.title: Can advocates elected to Toronto council help fix housing and homelessness crisis?
canada.summary: Toronto's newly elected council includes several prominent advocates who say they will bring the kind of first-hand outreach experience to the table that council needs.
canada.outlet: Global News + CityNews + CP24 + CBC News (CP)

canada.title: Ottawa spent over $3M in connection with Bill 21 challenge
canada.summary: Bill 21 bans certain government employees in positions of authority from wearing religious symbols, while requiring anyone providing or receiving a government service to have their face uncovered.

canada.title: Bye bye flavoured vapes: N.L. quickly moves bill through
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador will give retailers at least six months from when the current sitting of the House of Assembly wraps up, but intends to see flavoured vape products removed from store shelves.

canada.title: Sask. expands coverage for 2 drugs used to treat ovarian cancer
canada.summary: The drugs will be used for women who have stopped responding to platinum chemotherapy. The province estimates as many as 10 women will be eligible for the drug treatment each year.

canada.title: Lack of managers on the job leads to major spending decision delay at Prince George city hall
canada.summary: Prince George's new city council postponed deciding on whether to undo a major spending decision regarding upgrades to the exterior of the city's biggest arena in part due to the absence of multiple key management positions.

canada.title: Snowfall set to interrupt Saskatchewan's relatively balmy November
canada.summary: Winter is finally arriving in Saskatchewan, starting with a snowfall warning for Maple Creek. Environment and Climate Change Canada issued the warning Tuesday afternoon, saying the snow is expected to begin overnight.

canada.title: Yukon government backs three new positions for territory's water board
canada.summary: The government also signed a renewed memorandum of understanding with the Yukon Water Board laying out both parties’ responsibilities and commitment to work together.

canada.title: Wait for the most common diagnostic scans in Manitoba 'worse now than it ever has been': doctor
canada.summary: Doctors and patients say a diagnostic wait time crisis is putting people's lives at risk, as the highest number of Manitobans on record wait for scans that help diagnose brain tumours, heart disease and other potentially deadly medical conditions.

canada.title: Tattoo artists warn clients of AI-altered portfolios and deceptive marketing in southwestern Manitoba
canada.summary: A joint statement from nine Brandon tattoo studios says some artists are using AI-generated or altered photos to inflate their skills, deceive clients and recruit aspiring tattoo artists into paid mentorships.

canada.title: Patient numbers, poll data both improve for Holt Liberals
canada.summary: Premier Susan Holt’s focus on health care may be starting to pay dividends for patients and for her own political fortunes.

canada.title: Rick Hansen is still the Man in Motion, 40 years later
canada.summary: Rick Hansen made a stop in Fredericton as part of a national Man in Motion anniversary tour to reflect on progress made in accessibility 40 years after his global wheelchair marathon that raised awareness and sparked change for people with disabilities.

canada.title: Water, grid concerns raised at N.S. AI data centre Q&A
canada.summary: The first of three information sessions on the proposed $8-billion AI data centre project was held on Tuesday night. Locals asked questions about water usage, demands on the power grid and jobs.

canada.title: Fort Good Hope, N.W.T., awaits details from Ottawa on arena repairs
canada.summary: The community submitted a proposal for $11 million for arena repairs. But without knowing how much money the community is getting from Ottawa, it’s hard to gauge to what extent the community can refurbish its arena.

canada.title: ‘Not anymore’: N.L. judge denies bail to man who bragged about Canada's easy release
canada.summary: Justice Vikas Khaladkar roundly rejected a bail proposal from a man who texted the sister of his former intimate partner, saying: "I’ll get bail. This is Canada. She’ll be with me by the end of the day.”

SHENZHEN — Prime Minister Mark Carney has met with U.S. President Donald Trump in China, shortly after the prime minister said trade talks with Beijing are less complex than those with Washington.

SHENZHEN — Prime Minister Mark Carney has met with U.S. President Donald Trump in China. Carney’s office says the two leaders had a conversation that lasted just under 20 minutes, and that it included U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer and U.S. Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick. The meeting…
Carney and Trump met on the sidelines of the summit Wednesday for about 20 minutes, a meeting that was not initially on the schedule.
